title: Raply: A profanity-mitigated rap generator
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating profanity and slurs in rap lyrics generated by a GPT-2 model. While it mentions 'religious offense' as a category in its slur taxonomy and contains an 'Ethical Considerations' section, its primary objective is the technical reduction of offensive language (toxicity) rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
